summary: First-finish smoke testing for Mr. Wood Interiors site. Backend endpoints (leads POST/GET, /leads/stats, /chat streaming) and all key frontend flows (homepage load, lead form validation + success, testimonials carousel, FAQ accordion, sticky WhatsApp/Call links, AI chat widget streaming, admin dashboard with stats and leads table) verified end-to-end via public URL. No console errors observed.
passed: POST /api/leads -> 200 persists lead with UUID, defaults city=Jaipur, status=new
GET /api/leads -> 200 returns lead list including new record
POST /api/chat -> streams text response (verified 'Sure — how can I help?')
Homepage loads with correct title and quote-form + chat-toggle present
Lead form empty submit: no lead-success shown (validation blocks submit)
Lead form valid submit: lead-success element appears and lead saved (admin total increased from 2 -> 3)
Testimonials next button changes testimonial-quote text
FAQ accordion has 6 triggers and clicks/expands
Chat widget: chat-window opens, chat-send streams real AI reply (~450 chars) with wardrobe layout suggestions
/admin renders leads-table, stat-total=3, stat-new=3 in sync with backend
Zero JS console errors during full flow
